facts.business: Setco Automotive Limited manufactures automotive clutches and related components for original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket segments globally.

auditor.name: Sharp & Tannan Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) Reversal of provision for diminution in investment in Lava Cast Private Limited of Rs. 8,290 Lakhs; (b) Non-charging of interest on unsecured loans to/from subsidiaries; (c) Non-current investments of Rs 10,414 Lakhs with impairment provision of Rs 2,844 Lakhs.

facts.related_party_note: Company has not charged interest on unsecured loans to subsidiaries and has not provided interest on unsecured loan from subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Private Limited (SASPL), as per mutually agreed terms.
